definition: Data modeling represents entities, attributes, and relationships or other structures that determine how information is organized and used.
entry_text: Data modeling represents entities, attributes, and relationships or other structures that determine how information is organized and used.
example: A designer models orders and line items separately so each order can contain multiple products.
label: Data modeling

sources.note: Oracle documents designing logical, relational, and physical data models, with explicit entities, attributes, identifiers, and relations; this is a first-party tool example rather than a restriction to Oracle or relational design.
